plain_english: This non-dual thus said — nectar-of-knowledge unsurpassed — who may drink is quenched. His fever-of-saṃsāra-poison.
sanskrit_cite: etad advayam ity uktaṃ jñānāmṛtam anuttamam | yaḥ pibec chāmyate tasya saṃsāraviṣamūrchanam

plain_english: This bliss-of-awareness-method for attaining Śiva — of great souls, of king Kṣema-named — treatise extremely pure.
sanskrit_cite: bodhollāsavidhāneyaṃ śivaprāpyai mahātmanām | rājñaḥ kṣemābhidhānasya śāstram atyantanirmalam
